tools.name: synthesize_sql_query
tools.description: Translates natural language questions into dialect-accurate, optimized SQL SELECT queries with schema awareness and safety checks. Use when generating reporting queries or automated data analytics pipelines; for analyzing SQL execution performance and EXPLAIN plans, use analyze_query_plan instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'natural_language_request' and 'schema_ddl' ('sql_dialect' defaults to 'postgresql_dialect'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

natural_language_request.description: Natural language question or reporting requirement to transform into SQL.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining available tables, columns, and relations.

sql_dialect.description: Target SQL dialect specification: PostgreSQL dialect, MySQL dialect, or SQLite dialect.

read_only_mode.description: Whether to enforce strict read-only SELECT query constraints.

annotations.title: Deterministic NL-to-SQL Synthesizer & Dialect Query Generator

tools.name: audit_sql_injection_ast
tools.description: Statically parses SQL queries via AST lexical analysis to detect second-order injection, tautology conditions, and stacked queries. Use when auditing dynamic query parameters or untrusted user input before database execution; for sanitizing query strings for telemetry logging, use sanitize_sql_telemetry instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'raw_sql' ('audit_sensitivity' defaults to 'strict_zero_dynamic_taint'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

raw_sql.description: Raw SQL query string to parse and audit for injection vulnerabilities.

audit_sensitivity.description: Audit sensitivity mode: strict zero dynamic taint, second order injection check, or standard syntax audit.

allow_comments.description: Whether SQL inline comments are allowed or treated as injection vectors.

annotations.title: Deterministic SQL AST Injection & Tautology Vulnerability Auditor

tools.name: analyze_query_plan
tools.description: Analyzes SQL EXPLAIN execution plans to detect sequential table scans, high-cost cartesian joins, and buffer memory bottlenecks. Use when diagnosing slow queries, optimizing database performance, or evaluating query cost; for getting index recommendations, use recommend_database_indexes instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'explain_plan_or_query' ('optimization_target' defaults to 'eliminate_seq_scans'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

explain_plan_or_query.description: Raw text or JSON output of EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE or the candidate SQL query.

optimization_target.description: Optimization goal: eliminate sequential scans, reduce memory buffers, or minimize join costs.

annotations.title: SQL Query Plan EXPLAIN Optimizer & Bottleneck Diagnostics

tools.name: detect_breaking_migrations
tools.description: Compares source and target DDL schemas to identify breaking changes, destructive column drops, and lock-inducing mutations. Use when verifying CI/CD migration scripts before production deployment to prevent downtime; for verifying relational normal form, use validate_schema_normalization instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'current_schema' and 'target_schema' ('risk_tolerance' defaults to 'zero_downtime_strict'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

current_schema.description: Current production database DDL schema representing live tables and columns.

target_schema.description: Proposed new database DDL schema representing target migration state.

risk_tolerance.description: Deployment safety policy: zero downtime strict, allow transient locks, or permissive dev.

annotations.title: Database Schema Migration Differ & Breaking Change Linter

tools.name: transpile_sql_dialect
tools.description: Transpiles SQL queries and DDL schemas across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite dialects, rewriting functions and syntax quirks. Use when migrating application queries across database backends or testing against in-memory SQLite; for generating new queries from natural language, use synthesize_sql_query instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sql_code' and 'source_dialect' ('target_dialect' defaults to 'sqlite'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

sql_code.description: SQL query or DDL statement to convert from source dialect into target dialect.

source_dialect.description: Original SQL dialect of the input code: postgresql, mysql, or sqlite.

target_dialect.description: Destination SQL dialect to transpile into: postgresql, mysql, or sqlite.

annotations.title: Polyglot SQL Dialect Transpiler (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)

tools.name: recommend_database_indexes
tools.description: Recommends optimal single-column and composite B-Tree/BRIN indexes based on slow query WHERE, JOIN, and ORDER BY clauses. Use when optimizing database response times and eliminating full-table scans; for inspecting full execution plans, use analyze_query_plan instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'slow_queries_or_workload' ('index_type_preference' defaults to 'btree_and_composite'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

slow_queries_or_workload.description: Collection of slow SQL queries or workload log statements to analyze for index gaps.

index_type_preference.description: Target indexing strategy: B-tree and composite, BRIN and GIN sparse, or covering indexes with INCLUDE.

max_new_indexes.description: Maximum number of index creation statements to recommend.

annotations.title: Database Index Advisor & Composite B-Tree Optimizer

tools.name: validate_schema_normalization
tools.description: Audits database schemas for third normal form (3NF) compliance, transitive dependencies, and missing foreign key constraints. Use when reviewing database architectures, preventing update anomalies, or validating relational integrity; for detecting breaking schema migrations, use detect_breaking_migrations instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('target_normal_form' defaults to 'third_normal_form_3nf'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining table columns, primary keys, and relations.

target_normal_form.description: Target normalization standard: 3NF, Boyce-Codd BCNF, or denormalized OLAP star.

strict_keys.description: Whether to enforce explicit foreign key constraints on all ID references.

annotations.title: Relational Schema Normalization Auditor (3NF, BCNF) & Integrity Guard

tools.name: sanitize_sql_telemetry
tools.description: Masks PII, financial values, and credential literals from raw SQL query logs and slow-query dumps before telemetry storage. Use when scrubbing production database query logs before shipping to APM tools, Datadog, or external log collectors; for auditing SQL injection vulnerabilities, use audit_sql_injection_ast instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'query_logs' ('masking_policy' defaults to 'mask_pii_and_literals'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

query_logs.description: Raw SQL query text or multi-line database query log strings requiring sanitization.

masking_policy.description: Scrubbing rigor policy: mask PII and literals, anonymize all constants, or strict AST parameterization.

hash_salt.description: Optional salt string for deterministic pseudonymization of user IDs.

annotations.title: SQL Query Telemetry PII Scrubber & Parameterization Masker

tools.name: synthesize_seed_fixtures
tools.description: Generates deterministic relational test seed fixtures respecting foreign key constraints, unique indexes, and data bounds. Use when provisioning mock database datasets for automated testing, staging environments, or sandbox demos; for compiling ORM models from schemas, use generate_orm_models instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('fixture_volume' defaults to 'minimal_smoke_test_5'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

schema_ddl.description: Target database schema DDL defining tables, column types, and foreign key relations.

fixture_volume.description: Mock dataset volume profile: minimal smoke test (5), standard dataset (50), or stress dataset (500).

deterministic_seed.description: Integer seed for reproducible pseudo-random data generation.

annotations.title: Deterministic Relational Seed Data & SQL Mock Fixture Generator

tools.name: calculate_pool_headroom
tools.description: Calculates optimal connection pool sizing, idle timeouts, and client headroom based on server RAM and concurrency profile. Use when sizing PgBouncer, HikariCP, or Prisma connection pools to avoid server out-of-memory crashes; for checking transaction isolation hazards, use audit_transaction_isolation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'server_ram_mb' and 'max_concurrent_clients' ('workload_profile' defaults to 'high_concurrency_oltp'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

server_ram_mb.description: Total available RAM in megabytes dedicated to the database server instance.

max_concurrent_clients.description: Peak anticipated concurrent client connections or serverless worker threads.

workload_profile.description: Workload operational characteristics: high-concurrency OLTP, heavy analytical OLAP, or serverless edge burst.

annotations.title: Database Connection Pool Sizing & Concurrency Headroom Calculator

tools.name: audit_transaction_isolation
tools.description: Audits database transaction workflows for concurrency anomalies, dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and deadlock risks. Use when reviewing financial transfer procedures, inventory decrement operations, or multi-step checkout workflows; for calculating connection pool headroom, use calculate_pool_headroom instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'transaction_steps' ('target_isolation_level' defaults to 'read_committed'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

transaction_steps.description: Sequential SQL commands or description of business operations within the transaction.

target_isolation_level.description: Candidate SQL isolation level: read committed, repeatable read, or serializable.

strict_deadlock_check.description: Whether to perform exhaustive cross-table lock acquisition ordering analysis.

annotations.title: Transaction Concurrency Anomaly & Isolation Level Hazard Auditor

tools.name: generate_orm_models
tools.description: Compiles SQL DDL schemas into type-safe ORM entities and TypeScript validation schemas (Prisma, Drizzle, SQLAlchemy, Zod). Use when scaffolding application models, generating TypeScript data layers, or synchronizing schemas; for translating raw SQL across dialects, use transpile_sql_dialect instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('orm_target' defaults to 'drizzle_orm_typescript'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining tables, primary keys, and relationships.

orm_target.description: Target ORM framework standard: Prisma schema, Drizzle ORM TypeScript, SQLAlchemy Python 2.0, or Zod types.

include_relations.description: Whether to generate explicit foreign key relation decorators and navigation properties.

annotations.title: SQL DDL to Type-Safe ORM Entity Compiler (Prisma, Drizzle, Zod)
